method.record_definition: Two records are duplicates when all parsed CSV field values are identical.
method.serialization: Each UTF-8 field is encoded with its byte length before its contents. This prevents delimiter ambiguity.
method.normalization: No trimming, case conversion, missing-value replacement, or other field normalization is performed.
method.csv_formatting: CSV quoting and line-ending differences do not create different records when parsed field values are identical.
method.collision_protection: The complete serialized record is compared whenever an existing digest is encountered.
method.record_numbers: Source locations use one-based logical CSV record numbers.
method.raw_data_handling: Original CSV files are read only and are never modified.
